host_pcb_constraints_summary: Differential CK / CK# matched-length routing (≤ 25 mil intra-pair skew at DDR3-1600); typical 100 Ω differential impedance.
Single-ended CA / CTRL routing matched in length to CK within ≤ 50 mil per byte lane budget; impedance-controlled 50 Ω.
Per-byte-lane DQ / DQS routing matched within ≤ 25 mil intra-lane; DQS / DQS# matched ≤ 5 mil; impedance 40-50 Ω.
Fly-by topology for CA / CTRL on multi-DRAM modules (DIMMs); end-of-line termination resistors (typ. 39 Ω to VTT = VDD/2).
On-die termination (ODT) replaces external DQ / DQS termination; controller configures Rtt_Nom (MR1) and Rtt_WR (MR2) per the channel topology.
Bypass capacitors on VDD and VDDQ: typically 0.1 µF ceramic per supply pin pair + 4.7 µF / 10 µF bulk per DRAM.
VTT supply (= VDDQ/2) for CA termination resistors; low-impedance source with active regulator (DDR3 VTT regulator IC).
VREFCA and VREFDQ generation via low-noise voltage divider or dedicated reference IC; ±1% accuracy.
240 Ω ±1% resistor on each DRAM's ZQ pin to ground (or shared between two DRAMs if their ZQ windows do not overlap).
Power-supply sequencing: VDD ramp + VDDQ ramp + VTT ramp + VREF ramp before RESET# deassertion.
RESET# generation by the controller / SoC reset block (push-pull CMOS 1.5 V); board pull-up to VDD typical.
Module form-factor mechanical compliance per JEDEC JESD21-C MO-269 (UDIMM), MO-274 (SODIMM), MO-275 (RDIMM).
fields.dram_internal_constraints: DRAM-die-internal PDK, SDC, and layout constraints are vendor-specific (DRAM process at 50-30 nm class for the DDR3 generation) and intentionally out of scope. Internal cell-array trim, sense-amp bias, charge-pump levels are not exposed at the bus interface.
fields.notes: JESD79-3C standardizes electrical AC/DC parameters at the package balls (Sections 7-13) but no internal PDK / floorplan / SDC content. DDR3 controller and PHY IP from vendors (Synopsys, Cadence, Xilinx, Intel) ship their own SDC + UPF + DFT files tailored to specific PDK nodes and SoC integration scenarios. JEDEC JESD21-C is the companion module-level specification covering DIMM mechanical, SPD, and module-level signal integrity.
